bio: At Mitou, the prowess and ingenuity of the chef duo Kwon Young-woon and Kim Bo-mi are showcased through authentic Japanese cuisine prepared with fresh seasonal ingredients. Indeed, their unwavering commitment to incorporating seasonality into the menu starts with a careful selection of quality ingredients. In particular, chicken, eggs, rice and vegetables used at this establishment are sourced from Chef Kwon’s family farm. A culmination of such painstaking effort, the fare at Mitou genuinely reflects a sense of earnestness, modesty and dedication harbored by the two chefs as eternal students of culinary art. It thus comes as no surprise that customers eagerly anticipate Mitou’s new offerings every season....
